title: kbwho keeps a linked worktree's existing operator alias and mints a first alias once under a lock
goal: kbwho moves an alias a linked worktree's own _private/operators.json already holds into the clone's file instead of minting a new one, and two first-time callers for one email get one alias

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); C = os.path.join(T, "c")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copy(".gitignore", C)
B = os.path.join(T, "b"); os.makedirs(B)
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"
p = os.path.join(B, "claude"); open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho '{\"email\": \"%s\"}'\n" % EM); os.chmod(p, 0o755)
E = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
E.update(PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"], GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
         GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t" + chr(64) + "example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t" + chr(64) + "example.com")
def g(*a, cwd=C):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=E, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
def start(d):
    return subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, os.path.join(d, "_tools", "kbwho.py"), "--json"], cwd=d, env=E, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
W = os.path.join(T, "w"); g("worktree", "add", "-q", "--detach", W)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(W, "_private")); open(os.path.join(W, "_private", "operators.json"), "w").write(json.dumps({EM: "op-feedface"}))
kept = json.loads(start(W).communicate()[0] or "{}").get("id") == "op-feedface"
C2 = os.path.join(T, "c2"); shutil.copytree(C, C2, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("_private"))
ids = {json.loads(p.communicate()[0] or "{}").get("id") for p in [start(C2) for _ in range(8)]}
print("worktree alias kept:", kept, "ids of 8 first-time calls:", len(ids)); sys.exit(0 if kept and len(ids) == 1 else 1)
